name: The Balloon Library of Floating Memories
description: A library without walls, floating in a calm stratosphere. Books are gas-filled balloons -- each contains a memory written in scented vapor. Readers inhale a balloon's essence to experience the memory. Colors indicate emotional tone.
prompt: Serene stratosphere library. No walls, just floating platforms connected by rope bridges. Thousands of memory-balloons tethered: each a translucent sphere containing swirling colored vapor. Colors = emotions: gold (joy), blue (sorrow), green (growth), rose (love), violet (wisdom), amber (nostalgia). Readers sit on cloud-benches, inhaling from balloon-straws to experience memories as immersive VR-like visions projected around them. Balloons glow internally. Some are ancient (faded sepia), some new (vivid). Sunset lighting through vapor clouds. Peaceful, contemplative atmosphere. Weightless architecture.
caption: Don't read the memory. Breathe it. 🎈📖 Each balloon holds a life in scented vapor. Gold for joy. Blue for the goodbyes. Inhale and you're there -- the summer afternoon, the hospital hallway, the first kiss. Which color would you choose?
